speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Joan has them. I can walk as if this path were mine for an hour, and I mean to use the hour for walking.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The stubble is short. I am with thee. I am not starting a speech at a hedge.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Then do not start one. The yard is at the end of this. The walking is the part I came out for.
